prompt:
Image 1 is the official park map of the Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk: the whole park, from the west end at the left to the San Lorenzo River at the right. It sets the LAYOUT: keep its exact framing and camera angle, and keep every ride, building, path, street, parking lot, tree, the beach edge and the river in the same place, at the same size and with the same shape. Images 2 and 3 are our style frames; image 2 is the middle of this same park already redrawn in our style. Redraw all of image 1 in exactly that style, so that image 2's area would fit into the result seamlessly.

Style (images 2 and 3): thin outlines tinted as darker versions of each fill (a very dark warm brown only where an outline needs it), soft gentle shading, a gentle paper texture, the warm pastel palette (salmon, peach, butter yellow, cornflower blue, mint, lavender grey), rounded toy-like proportions, crisp clean detail, every ride clearly readable.

Where things stand (where each one meets the ground, as a share of the picture's width across and height down):
- Cocoanut Grove, a white 1907 ballroom with a glass-roofed Sun Room: 10% across, 46% down. The Casino Arcade behind it at 10% across, 33% down. The bowling alley in the top left corner.
- Neptune's Kingdom, a big pale hall with a curved glass roof: 21% across, 42% down.
- The Pirate Ship, a big swinging ship: 24% across, 65% down, near the beach.
- Typhoon, a tall looping arm: 27% across, 47% down. Double Shot, a tall drop tower: 27% across, 67% down.
- Shockwave, a half-pipe with a spinning disc: 31% across, 42% down.
- The Undertow, a spinning roller coaster with bright yellow track, built on top of a roof: 35% across, 45% down. The Wave Rider giant slide next to it.
- The Looff Carousel in its building with a round domed roof: 44% across, 46% down. The Haunted Castle, a small castle: 48% across, 54% down.
- The Sky Glider chairlift: a line of small hanging chairs on a cable along the park, from about 30% to 65% across.
- Fireball, a tall pendulum ride: a red-and-yellow ring of seats swinging on a single tall arm, NOT a wheel: 58% across, 64% down.
- The Giant Dipper, a long white wooden roller coaster with dark red track, filling the upper middle from about 52% to 85% across, its tallest hill near 69% across.
- The Dream Wheel, a Ferris wheel with colourful cabins: 69% across, 78% down. It is the only Ferris wheel in the park.
- Sea Swings, chairs on chains under a canopy: 72% across, 82% down. Funland Arcade, a low building: 76% across, 83% down.
- Logger's Revenge, a log flume with a brown wooden mill house and long teal water chutes: 82% across, 66% down.
- The east end, 85% to 95% across: Ghost Blasters, the Cave Train's rock, Tornado, Crazy Surf, teacups, Tsunami under its round tent, Rock-O-Plane and small kiddie rides, each a distinct small ride.
- The San Lorenzo River at the far right, with a dark steel railway trestle bridge across it at 90% across, 33% down.
- Behind the park: Beach Street, parking lots with a few small cars, palm trees, the US and California flags on poles, low town buildings along the top edge.
- In front: one tidy wooden retaining wall with a white rail along the whole beach edge, wooden staircases down to the sand every so often, the wide sandy beach, and at the bottom left the sea: flat blue water with short white ripples and curling white foam where it meets the sand.
- Along the inside of the beach wall runs a clear, open wooden promenade the whole length of the park, wide enough for crowds to walk, with benches, lamps and a few food stalls.

Image 1 is a map, so leave out everything that is map graphics, not a real object: number circles, round icons (food, toilets, ATM, information, cameras, parking), pink badges, labels, street names, the logo at the bottom left (draw beach and sea there instead) and the multicoloured stripe drawn along the beach edge. Do not draw any people or animals anywhere. Do not draw any text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures or watermarks.

Framing is strict: the output must line up with image 1 when laid on top of it. Same framing and zoom as image 1: do not zoom out, do not crop, and do not add anything beyond image 1's edges.
